questions_and_answers.question_text: In the Peking dialect, where does the -de of a shi...de construction come?
Is the object inside or outside the shi...de construction in the Peking dialect?
What do some other Standard Chinese speakers do with the object?
Write the Chinese for "I studied it in Washington."
Write the Chinese question meaning "Where did you study it?"
Which dialect is the model for the grammatical patterns presented in this course?

answers.answer_text: The Peking dialect of Standard Chinese.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "I studied English at Taiwan University."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ shi zài Táiwān Dàxué xuéde Yīngwén.

questions_and_answers.question_text: In Wǒ shi zài zhèli xuéde Yīngwén, where does Yīngwén stand?

answers.answer_text: After the -de — outside the shi...de construction.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the Chinese word for "university"?
Which construction is used in both these exchanges to focus on the place of study?

articles.text:
10. A: Nǐ shi zài nǎli xuéde?               Where did you study it?
    B: Wǒ shi zài Huáshèngdùn                I studied it in Washington.
       xuéde.

11. B: Nǐ shi zài dàxué xuéde                Did you study English at college?
       Yīngwén ma?
    A: Shìde, wǒ shi zài Táiwān              Yes, I studied English at Taiwan
       Dàxué xuéde Yīngwén.                  University.

Note on Nos. 10-11

In the Peking dialect of Standard Chinese, which is the model for grammatical patterns presented in this course, the -de of a shi...de construction comes between the verb and its object. The object, therefore, is outside the shi...de construction. Compare "I studied here" with "I studied English here":

Wǒ | shi | zài zhèli | xué | -de |
Wǒ | shi | zài zhèli | xué | -de | Yīngwén

However, you may hear some Standard Chinese speakers who place the object inside the shi...de construction.
